Operated the supplier risk process for the three plants' critical parts, maintaining the critical supplier register and conducting quarterly risk reviews with plant maintenance managers. (src_a679dc0ba8bd)

Supported the capital equipment tenders run by the team leader for kiln refurbishment, preparing tender documents and bid comparison; the tender board submissions were made by the team leader. (src_44cf1756c287)
Wrote the annual procurement boundary note for each of the three plants and closed two internal audit findings raised against the plants' purchase order controls in 2024. (src_8c5e99f16245)
experienceHighlights: Buyer for three plants' maintenance parts and contracted services under group procurement policy. (src_9d05ad456645)

projectsAndWorkSamples: Critical supplier register and quarterly risk review pack for one plant. (src_dd7280cb8ef1)
